up: Return the first 1000 rows from the activities table that meet all of the following conditions: (1) The target is CHEMBL1744522 (Endothelial PAS domain-containing protein 1), which is a human single-protein target; (2) The activity standard_type is 'IC50'; (3) The standard_relation is exactly '='; (4) The pchembl_value is not null. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID. Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value.
sql:
WITH target_activities AS (
  SELECT
    a.assay_id,
    a.molregno,
    a.standard_type,
    a.pchembl_value,
    td.target_type,
    td.tax_id
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1744522'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  ta.target_type,
  ta.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  ta.standard_type,
  ta.pchembl_value
FROM target_activities ta
JOIN assays ass ON ta.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON ta.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON ta.molregno = cs.molregno
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
